chapter_name: A Tale of Valour: Major Somnath Sharma and the Battle of Badgam
learning_objective: 🎯 Get inspired by the supreme bravery, leadership, and ultimate sacrifice of India's first Param Vir Chakra awardee!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Meet Major Somnath Sharma, a true Indian hero. Even with a fractured arm, he insisted on joining his troops in Kashmir because his country needed him the most.
Outnumbered by the enemy, Major Sharma and his brave men fought fearlessly. He ran from post to post, motivating his soldiers and showing unmatched courage under heavy fire.
Major Sharma gave his life to protect the Srinagar airport and our nation. For his ultimate bravery, he became the first recipient of the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military honor.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ A Letter to Our Heroes
fun_activity.instructions: Write a short, heartfelt thank-you note to the brave soldiers of the Indian Army who stay awake day and night to keep our borders and our homes safe.

quick_recap: ⭐ Major Somnath Sharma showed incredible dedication by leading his men despite a severe injury.
⭐ His brilliant leadership at Badgam saved the Srinagar airport from falling into enemy hands.
⭐ He is remembered eternally as the first brave soul to receive the Param Vir Chakra.
